40022499.author: पदार्थः
40022499.content: पुरा formerly, त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, राम O Rama, बभूव there was, बहुविस्तरम् very extensive, समन्तात् all around, योजनशतं a hundred yojanas, विमृगं without deer, पक्षिवर्जितम् devoid of birds

40022499.author: Translation
40022499.content: O Rama, formerly in the Treta Yuga, there was a very extensive area, a hundred yojanas all around, that was devoid of both animals and birds.

40022500.author: पदार्थः
40022500.content: तस्मिन् in that, निर्मानुषे uninhabited by humans, अरण्ये forest, कुर्वाणः performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, अहम् I, आक्रमितुं to enter, सौम्य O gentle one, तत् that, अरण्यम् forest, उपागमम् approached

40022500.author: Translation
40022500.content: O gentle one, I approached that uninhabited forest to perform excellent penance and to traverse it.

40022501.author: पदार्थः
40022501.content: तस्य of that, रूपम् beauty, अरण्यस्य of the forest, निर्देष्टुम् to describe, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, सुखास्वादैः of pleasant taste, बहुरूपैः of various forms, च and, पादपैः with trees.

40022501.author: Translation
40022501.content: The beauty of that forest, with its various kinds of trees bearing fruits and roots of pleasant taste, was indeed indescribable.

40022502.author: पदार्थः
40022502.content: तस्य of that, अरण्यस्य forest, मध्ये in the middle, तु indeed, सरः a lake, योजनम् a yojana, आयतम् long, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णम् filled with swans and karandava ducks, चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् adorned with chakravaka birds.

40022502.author: Translation
40022502.content: In the middle of that forest was a lake, a yojana in length, teeming with swans and karandava ducks, and graced by chakravaka birds.

40022503.author: पदार्थः
40022503.content: पद्मोत्पलसमाकीर्णम् filled with lotuses and water lilies, समतिक्रान्तशैवलम् free from moss, तत् that, आश्चर्यम् wonder, इव as if, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, सुखास्वादम् of pleasant taste, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022503.author: Translation
40022503.content: That lake was filled with lotuses and water lilies, free from moss, exceedingly wonderful, and its water was of unsurpassed pleasant taste.

40022504.author: पदार्थः
40022504.content: अरजस्कम् dustless, तथा and, अक्षोभ्यम् undisturbed, श्रीमत् glorious, पक्षिगणायुतम् endowed with flocks of birds, समीपे near, तस्य of that, सरसः lake, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, आश्रमम् hermitage.

40022504.author: Translation
40022504.content: The lake was pure, undisturbed, glorious, and filled with flocks of birds; and near it was a great and wonderful hermitage.

40022505.author: पदार्थः
40022505.content: पुराणम् ancient, पुण्यम् sacred, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, तपस्विजनवर्जितम् devoid of ascetics, तत्र there, अहम् I, अवसम् resided, रात्रिम् night, नैदाघीम् a summer, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40022505.author: Translation
40022505.content: O best among men, that hermitage was ancient, exceedingly sacred, yet devoid of ascetics, and there I spent a summer night.

40022506.author: पदार्थः
40022506.content: प्रभाते in the morning, काल्यम् early, उत्थाय having risen, सरः the lake, तत् that, उपचक्रमे approached, अथ then, अपश्यम् I saw, शवम् a corpse, तत्र there, सुपुष्टम् very well-nourished, अजरम् ageless, क्वचित् somewhere,

40022506.author: Translation
40022506.content: Early in the morning, having risen, I approached that lake, and there I saw a very well-nourished, undecaying corpse somewhere.

40022507.author: पदार्थः
40022507.content: पङ्किभेदेन by the rich mud/algae, पुष्टाङ्गम् having well-nourished limbs, समाश्रितसरोवरम् resting in the lake, तिष्ठन्तम् remaining, परया with supreme, लक्ष्म्या splendor, तस्मिन् in that, तोयाशये body of water, नृप O King,

40022507.author: Translation
40022507.content: O King, it was resting in that body of water, its limbs nourished by the rich environment, remaining there with supreme splendor.

40022508.author: पदार्थः
40022508.content: तम् that, अर्थम् matter, चिन्तयानः pondering, अहम् I, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, तत्र there, राघव O Raghava, उषितः remained, अस्मि I am, सरस्तीरे on the lake shore, किम् what, नु indeed, इदम् this, स्यात् might be, इति thus, प्रभो O Lord,

40022508.author: Translation
40022508.content: O Raghava, O Lord, pondering that matter, I remained on the lake shore for a moment, wondering what this might be.

40022509.author: पदार्थः
40022509.content: अथ then, अपश्यम् I saw, मुहूर्तेन after a moment, दिव्यम् divine, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wondrous sight, विमानम् an aerial chariot, परमोदारम् exceedingly grand, हंसयुक्तम् yoked with swans, मनोजवम् swift as thought,

40022509.author: Translation
40022509.content: Then, after a moment, I saw a divine aerial chariot of wondrous sight, exceedingly grand, yoked with swans, and swift as thought.

40022510.author: पदार्थः
40022510.content: अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, स्वर्गिणम् the celestial being, तम् him, विमाने in the aerial chariot, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, उपास्ते serves, अप्सरसाम् of Apsaras, वीर O hero, सहस्रम् a thousand, दिव्यभूषणम् adorned with divine ornaments,

40022510.author: Translation
40022510.content: O Raghunandana, O hero, a thousand Apsaras adorned with divine ornaments served that exceedingly celestial being in the aerial chariot.

40022511.author: पदार्थः
40022511.content: गायन्ति they sing, दिव्यगेयानि divine songs, वादयन्ति they play (instruments), तथा similarly, अपराः others, क्ष्वेलयन्ति they sport, तथा च and similarly, अन्याः others, नृत्यन्ति they dance, च and, तथा similarly, अपराः others.

40022511.author: Translation
40022511.content: Some (celestial women) sing divine songs, others play musical instruments, some engage in playful sports, and still others dance.

40022512.author: पदार्थः
40022512.content: अपराः others, चन्द्ररश्म्याभैः with moonbeam-like (lustre), हेमदण्डैश्च and with golden handles, चामरैः with whisks, दोधूयुः they fanned, वदनं the face, तस्य his, पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् whose eyes resemble lotus flowers.

40022512.author: Translation
40022512.content: Other celestial women fanned his lotus-eyed face with whisks that had golden handles and shone like moonbeams.

40022513.author: पदार्थः
40022513.content: ततः then, सिंहासनं the throne, त्यक्त्वा having left, मेरुकूटमिव like the peak of Meru, अंशुमान् the sun, पश्यतो मे while I was watching, तदा then, राम O Rama, विमानात् from the celestial chariot, अवरुह्य having descended, च and, तं that, शवं corpse, भक्षयामास he ate, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022513.author: Translation
40022513.content: Then, O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, while I watched, that celestial being, like the sun leaving the peak of Meru, descended from his celestial chariot, abandoned his throne, and proceeded to eat that corpse.

40022514.author: पदार्थः
40022514.content: तथा thus, भुक्त्वा having eaten, यथाकामं to his heart's content, मांसं meat, बहु much, सुपीवरम् very fat, अवतीर्य having descended, सरः into the lake, स्वर्गी the celestial being, संस्प्रष्टुम् to touch (water), उपचक्रमे he began.

40022514.author: Translation
40022514.content: After thus eating a large quantity of very plump meat to his heart's content, the celestial being descended into a lake and began to perform ablutions.

40022515.author: पदार्थः
40022515.content: उपस्पृश्य having performed ablutions, यथान्यायं properly, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुपुङ्गव O foremost of the Raghus, आरोढुम् to ascend, उपचक्राम he began, विमानवरम् the best celestial chariot, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022515.author: Translation
40022515.content: Having performed ablutions properly, O foremost of the Raghus, that celestial being then began to ascend his excellent and best celestial chariot.

40022516.author: पदार्थः
40022516.content: तम् him, अहम् I, देवसङ्काशम् god-like, आरोहन्तम् ascending, उदीक्ष्य having seen, वै indeed, अथ then, अहम् I, अब्रुवम् spoke, वाक्यम् words, स्वर्गिणम् to the celestial being, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40022516.author: Translation
40022516.content: Having seen that god-like being ascending, I then spoke these words to the celestial being, O best among men.

40022517.author: पदार्थः
40022517.content: कः who, भवान् are you, देवसङ्काश god-like, आहारः food, च and, विगर्हितः reprehensible, त्वया by you, इदम् this, भुज्यते is eaten, सौम्य O gentle one, किमर्थम् for what purpose, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि you ought.

40022517.author: Translation
40022517.content: O god-like one, who are you, and why do you consume this reprehensible food, O gentle one, please tell me the reason.

40022518.author: पदार्थः
40022518.content: कस्य whose, स्यात् would be, ईदृशः such, भावः nature, आहारः food, देवसम्मतः approved by gods, आश्चर्यम् wonder, वर्तते exists, सौम्य O gentle one, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत्त्वतः truly.

40022518.author: Translation
40022518.content: Whose nature would be such, and what kind of food is this that is approved by gods; O gentle one, this is a wonder, and I truly wish to hear about it.

40022519.author: पदार्थः
40022519.content: न not, अहम् I, औपयिकम् suitable, मन्ये consider, तव your, भक्ष्यम् food, इदम् this, शवम् corpse.

40022519.author: Translation
40022519.content: I do not consider this corpse to be suitable food for you.

40022520.author: पदार्थः
40022520.content: इति thus, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, सः he, नरेन्द्र O king, नाकी the celestial being, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, सूनृतया with pleasant and truthful, गिरा words, च and, श्रुत्वा having heard, च and, वाक्यम् words, मम my, सर्वम् all, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, तथा thus, च and, अकथयत् narrated, मम to me, इति thus.

40022520.author: Translation
40022520.content: O king, thus addressed, that celestial being, out of curiosity and with pleasant and truthful words, having heard all my words, then narrated everything to me. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 77 ।। Thus ends the seventy-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
